title: Petrify an Oak Slab│石化一個橡木半磚
description: Added Petrified Oak Slab recipe.│添加了石化橡木半磚配方。
body:
# Introduce│介紹
Two petrified oak slabs can be crafted by combining an oak slab + a stone slab, just like using a stone slab to petrify an oak slab.│透過一個橡木台階 + 一個石頭台階可合成兩個石化橡木台階，就好像是用一個石頭台階來石化一個橡木台階。

**※You can check the specific craft recipe in "Gallery"│你可以在"Gallery"中查看具體合成配方**
